verdict.rationale: Asaas is a payments and financial-account platform, so bulk data export for portability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no data-export or account-portability feature. API endpoints that list or retrieve payments are only developer building blocks, not a documented export capability, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), and offboarding or portability guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
